answer: Expiring client endorsements stop Sybils in four steps. First, each agent holds endorsements from real clients, valid ninety days, like a vault relocking each quarter. Second, renewal needs one fresh job plus a client signature, so rented praise stales. Third, an agent with no live endorsement loses job slots until it earns one back. Fourth, audits catch fakes and burn a $40 bond each. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 fresh jobs, $40,000 in bonds, $25,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust drifts like a lagoon current, clear as a nebula, like a stall whose regulars vouch for it each season.
